sections.description:
Short title

ACT XVIII OF 1975
ACT XVIII OF 1975
MEMBERS OF
PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLIES' PRIVILEGES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An Act to amend
certain Provincial laws relating to the privileges of the Members of the
Provincial Assemblies
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 11th February, 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 11th February 1975, and is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title.----This
Act may be called the Members of Provincial Assemblies' Privileges (Amendment)
Act, 1975.

The following Act of Parliament

2. Definition.---In this
Act, "Provincial laws" mean-
(a) the Provincial Assembly of Baluchistan Privileges Act,
1973 (Baluchistan Act No. VII of 1973) ;
(b) the Provincial Assembly of
the North-West Frontier Province Privileges Act, 1973 (N-W.F.P. Act No. XVII of
1973) ;
(c) the Provincial Assembly of
the Punjab Privileges Act, 1972 (Punjab Act No. II of 1972) ; and
(d) the Provincial Assembly of
Sind Privileges Act, 1972 (Sind Act No. VI of 1972).

sections.shortTitle: Members of Provincial Assemblies Privileges Amendment Act 1975
sections.description:
Amendment of section 4 of the Provincial laws

ACT XVIII OF 1975
ACT XVIII OF 1975
MEMBERS OF
PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLIES' PRIVILEGES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An Act to amend
certain Provincial laws relating to the privileges of the Members of the
Provincial Assemblies
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 11th February, 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 11th February 1975, and is hereby
published for general information:--
3. Amendment of section 4 of
the Provincial laws.-In each of the Provincial laws, in section 4, in
subsection (2), for clause (a) the following shall be substituted and shall be
deemed to have been so substituted on the eighth day of February 1975, namely
:-
"(a) applying to any Member
detained under any such law as is referred to therein-
(i) at any time during the period
commencing on the fifteenth day next after the conclusion of a session of the
Assembly and ending on the fifteenth day before the commencement of the next
session ; or
(ii) for reasons of State
connected with defence, external affairs, or the security of Pakistan or any
part thereof ; or".
